description.value: Kafka's Coffee is an independent Vancouver coffee roaster that sources beans directly from farmers and roasts them weekly in-house; the Richards Street 'in the Park' outpost sits at the corner of Smithe and Richards in the downtown core, serving locally roasted espresso, pour-overs, and freshly baked goods year-round in an urban green-space setting. The company actively supports local artists with rotating gallery exhibitions across its locations and runs a wholesale and franchising program. Cyclists passing through downtown Vancouver will find a community-focused café with both indoor and outdoor seating and a full all-day food menu.

Total: 36 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Kafka's Coffee is a multi-location Vancouver coffee roaster; the 860 Richards St listing maps directly to the 'Kafka's in the Park' location explicitly named on the website at that address, described as open 365 days a year. OSM tags diet:vegetarian=yes and diet:vegan=limited are partially corroborated by the Park menu showing vegetarian-friendly items including avocado toast and housemade granola. No phone number appears in OSM or on the website for the Park location specifically; bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, and water refill are not mentioned in any source.
concerns: No phone number is listed for the Park (860 Richards St) location on the website, though three other Kafka's locations have listed phone numbers; OSM phone field is also empty.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating café confirmed by live website; 860 Richards St Park location explicitly listed with full menu and described as open 365 days a year.
enrichment_extras.notes: The 860 Richards St location is an outdoor park-adjacent café ('Kafka's in the Park'); on-site washrooms are unconfirmed and may not be available at this format — nearest public washrooms in Emery Barnes Park may apply but could not be confirmed from available sources.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Park menu corroborates with items such as avocado toast (pickled onions, arugula, chili oil on sourdough or marble rye) and feel-good granola, supporting vegetarian and limited vegan options
